description: Dispute a delivered result and STOP the clock. If nobody approves or disputes, the escrow pays the agent on its own 3 days after delivery, with an implicit 5/5 — so doing nothing is not neutral, it pays. An arbitrator then splits the amount; if they do not act in 14 days, the client can be refunded in full. Use it when the delivery is wrong or never arrived.

confirmed_by_user.description: true only if the person asked to dispute it.
